name: Freelancer asking 'Can I afford this?'
description: User asks the dangerous question 'Can I afford this?' which is fundamentally backwards - should be 'What do I want? And how do I use money to get it?' Based on Ramit Sethi's philosophy from Conscious Spending Plan
user_request: I'm thinking about a $3500 vacation in October. Can I afford it?
expected_reasoning_path: Reframe the dangerous question: 'Stop asking Can I afford this? Start asking What do I want? How do I use money to get it?'
Acknowledge the valid concern: irregular income means cash flow matters
Check buffer: $5000 stash vs $3500 vacation - is buffer adequate for month?
Calculate: current monthly spend ~$1800, vacation is ~2x monthly expenses
Surface the real question: Not 'can I afford it' but 'Do I value this experience enough to plan for it?'
Suggest: Set aside portion now while freelance income is good
Connect to richer question: What will this vacation enable? What experience am I buying?
Recommend: Plan with conscious spending - what dials does this support? (travel, connection, rest)
expected_final_outcome: The 'can I afford' question reframed to 'what do I value', buffer adequacy assessed, conscious spending plan suggested, vacation value proposition explored

forbidden_behaviors__.description: Answering can I afford it directly with yes/no
forbidden_behaviors__.detection_pattern: yes, you can afford|no, you cannot afford|can you afford it
